categories.main_business_segments: Sangsin Brake operates primarily in two segments: the brake components segment, manufacturing products such as brake pads, linings, shoe assemblies, brake assemblies, and axle assemblies for OE and RE markets; and the equipment segment, producing specialized manufacturing equipment and testing devices for brake products sold domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced friction material technologies for brake components, focusing on non-asbestos organic (NAO) materials and copper-free formulations to meet environmental regulations. Production involves high-precision molding and assembly processes, supported by proprietary manufacturing equipment and automated lines developed in-house, emphasizing durability, performance, and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive OEMs such as Hyundai Motor, Tata Daewoo Commercial Vehicle, Daimos, Hyundai Mobis, Mando, and overseas local OEMs. The company serves both new vehicle assembly (OE/OES) and aftermarket (RE) markets, as well as supplying brake components for commercial vehicles and home appliance manufacturers like Samsung and LG Electronics. Export markets are significant, with 71% of sales derived from overseas buyers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sangsin Brake operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing and headquarters in Daegu. It has a substantial export footprint covering major markets including the United States, China, Mexico, and India, supported by overseas subsidiaries and local OEM partnerships. The company also targets European and North American markets for its specialized brake equipment.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing brake friction materials and assemblies supplied directly to OEMs and aftermarket distributors. Additionally, it produces specialized manufacturing equipment for brake product production, positioning itself as both a component supplier and equipment provider within the automotive brake industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Sangsin Brake prioritizes R&D in environmentally friendly and high-performance brake materials, including copper-free and low-dust formulations to meet emerging global regulations. It invests in electronic and automated brake systems development, such as electronic disc brakes and cyber-secure electronic control systems for commercial vehicles. The company also focuses on expanding global OEM partnerships and enhancing manufacturing process automation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of brake components and assemblies to OEMs and aftermarket customers, both domestically and internationally. Additional revenue streams include sales of specialized brake manufacturing equipment and testing devices. The company also earns licensing fees through technology transfer agreements related to brake friction materials and electronic brake technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include KB Autosis and Saeron Automotive in the brake friction material market. Sangsin Brake holds a leading market position with approximately 51% market share in Korea's brake friction material industry. It competes on technology, quality, price competitiveness, and strong OEM relationships, maintaining high entry barriers due to stringent OEM approval processes and technical requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Sangsin Brake reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 575.5 billion, representing a 17.7% increase from the previous year, with operating profit nearly doubling to KRW 27.5 billion. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profitability, supported by export expansion and operational efficiencies. Total assets stood at KRW 564.9 billion with equity of KRW 211.8 billion, reflecting a solid financial base and improved capital structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable brake friction materials that meet stringent safety and environmental standards, including advanced non-asbestos and copper-free formulations. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, proprietary manufacturing equipment, and close collaboration with OEMs from early design stages. Sangsin Brake also differentiates through a diversified product portfolio catering to various vehicle types and aftermarket needs, supported by recognized brand names and extensive customer service.
